integrity: The theorem is supported by a standalone infinite p-adic difference-quotient proof, a finite-modulus recurrence proof and a separate exhaustive standard-library checker. The checker is corroboration rather than a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: New theorem concerns integer parameters v>=4 even, not previously known v=0 or v=2. The binary root is given by a precise convergent lifting algorithm; this is not a closed elementary formula. Potential unindexed prior coverage is a bibliographic risk. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact three-square obstruction densities for every higher even generalized derangement parameter
